title.zh: 由 1D 与 2D NMR 推出 C_{13}H_{16}N_{2}O_{2} 的结构

prompt.zh: 500 MHz 下测得 ^{1}H、^{13}C、DEPT、gCOSY、gHMQC 和 gHMBC。推出结构并归属每一个峰。
prompt.en: ^{1}H, ^{13}C, DEPT, gCOSY, gHMQC and gHMBC at 500 MHz. Deduce the structure and assign every peak.

note.zh: 全部位移和报告里写明的 COSY、HMQC、HMBC 相关都取自下面所列的实测报告。报告没有给 J 的数值，带 ≈ 的 J 是文献典型值；带 * 的相关峰是报告没有列出、按结构预期画的。
note.en: All shifts and the COSY, HMQC and HMBC correlations stated in the report are measured data from the source below. The report gives no J values in Hz, so J marked ≈ is a typical literature value; correlations marked * are not listed in the report and are drawn as expected from the structure.

answer.zh: 答案：N-[2-(5-甲氧基-1H-吲哚-3-基)乙基]乙酰胺（褪黑素）

sources.label: University of Utah, Dept. of Chemistry: melatonin NMR report, S. Clair and P. F. Flynn (500 MHz; 1H, 13C, DEPT, gCOSY, gHMQC, gHMBC)

covers.en: Measured: eight ^{1}H shifts (7.217, 7.059, 7.034, 6.755, 3.821, 3.449, 2.900, 1.918) with the multiplet shapes described in words (singlet, doublet, doublet of doublets, triplet); 13 ^{13}C shifts (173.290, 154.969, 133.407, 129.118, 124.158, 113.082, 112.909, 112.600, 101.257, 56.312, 41.519, 26.268, 22.645); gCOSY: H7/H6, and a weak H4/H6; gHMQC table: C6/H6, C7/H7, C2/H2, C4/H4; gHMBC table: C13 with H12 and H14, H11 with C3, C2 and C9, C5 with H10, H7 and H4; C8 assigned by elimination. Atom numbering follows the report (8 = indole C7a, 9 = C3a). The report states no solvent, no J values, and lists neither N–H.

rule.zh: 每个 N 在计算时加 1（公式里的 +2 来自两个 N），O 不计。不饱和度 ≥ 4 时先想芳环。
rule.en: Each N adds one to the count (the +2 comes from the two N); O is ignored. With 4 or more, think of an aromatic ring first.

so.zh: 7 个不饱和度：很可能有芳环，外加别的双键或环。
so.en: Seven degrees: very likely an aromatic ring, plus more double bonds or rings.

title.zh: 氢谱清点：14 个 H，少了 2 个

ask.zh: 8 组信号：4 个 1H、2 个 2H、2 个 3H。和分子式的 16 个 H 差多少？差的可能是什么？
ask.en: Eight signals: four 1H, two 2H, two 3H. How far is that from the 16 H of the formula, and what could be missing?

rule.zh: 连在 N 或 O 上的 H 可以和氘代溶剂（如 CD_{3}OD、D_{2}O）交换，交换后在氢谱里看不到。
rule.en: H on N or O can exchange with a deuterated solvent such as CD_{3}OD or D_{2}O, and then it does not show in the proton spectrum.

so.zh: 缺的 2 个 H 很可能是 N–H 或 O–H。
so.en: The two missing H are probably N–H or O–H.

check.zh: 报告没有写溶剂。这里看不到可交换的 H，又和 CD_{3}OD 中的位移相符，所以推测是在甲醇-d_{4} 中测的。这是推测，不是报告写的。
check.en: The report does not state the solvent. No exchangeable H is seen, and the shifts fit CD_{3}OD, so methanol-d_{4} is a guess. It is an inference, not something the report says.

text.en: Thirteen peaks: one at 173.3, eight between 101 and 155, one at 56.3, and three at 41.5, 26.3 and 22.6.

rule.en: An amide or ester C=O lies at 165–175; aromatic carbons at 100–160, with an O-bearing aromatic carbon at 150–160; OCH_{3} at 55–57.

so.zh: 一个酰胺或酯的 C=O、8 个芳碳（其中 154.97 连着 O），一个 OCH_{3}，三个饱和碳。
so.en: One amide or ester C=O, eight aromatic carbons (154.97 bearing an O), one OCH_{3} and three saturated carbons.

check.zh: 8 个芳碳比苯环多 2 个，说明芳香部分不只是一个苯环。
check.en: Eight aromatic carbons are two more than a benzene ring, so the aromatic part is more than one benzene ring.

title.zh: 两个甲基单峰：OCH_{3} 和 CH_{3}C=O
title.en: Two methyl singlets: OCH_{3} and CH_{3}C=O

rule.zh: 芳基甲醚的 OCH_{3} 在 3.7–3.9；乙酰基 CH_{3}C(=O)– 在 1.9–2.2，乙酰胺偏低端（约 1.9）。
rule.en: An aryl methyl ether OCH_{3} appears at 3.7–3.9; an acetyl CH_{3}C(=O)– at 1.9–2.2, with acetamides at the low end (about 1.9).

so.zh: 3.821 是芳环上的 OCH_{3}；1.918 是连在 C=O 上的 CH_{3}。
so.en: 3.821 is an OCH_{3} on the aromatic ring; 1.918 is a CH_{3} on a C=O.

check.zh: 这两个是按位移推的，下面用 HMBC 核对。
check.en: Both are shift-based guesses; HMBC checks them next.

text.en: The C=O at 173.3 correlates with both 1.918 (CH_{3}) and 3.449 (CH_{2}).

rule.zh: HMBC 看 2–3 键。CH_{3} 到 C=O 是 2 键；CH_{2} 要经过一个 N 才到 C=O，是 3 键。CH_{2} 的 δ_{H} 3.4–3.5 正是连在酰胺 N 上的范围。
rule.en: HMBC sees two or three bonds. CH_{3} to C=O is two bonds; the CH_{2} reaches the C=O through an N, three bonds. A δ_{H} of 3.4–3.5 is exactly the range for a CH_{2} on an amide N.

so.zh: 片段：CH_{3}–C(=O)–NH–CH_{2}–。用掉一个 N 和一个 O；这个 N–H 是缺的 H 之一。
so.en: Fragment: CH_{3}–C(=O)–NH–CH_{2}–. This uses one N and one O, and that N–H is one of the missing H.

check.zh: 若是酯（–O–CH_{2}–），CH_{2} 会在 4 ppm 以上。3.45 更符合酰胺。
check.en: For an ester (–O–CH_{2}–) the CH_{2} would sit above 4 ppm. 3.45 fits an amide better.

rule.zh: n+1 规则：三重峰说明邻碳上有 2 个 H。两个 CH_{2} 互为三重峰，就是 –CH_{2}–CH_{2}–。2.9 ppm 是接在芳环上的 CH_{2}。
rule.en: n+1 rule: a triplet means two H on the neighbouring carbon. Two CH_{2} that split each other into triplets form –CH_{2}–CH_{2}–. 2.9 ppm is typical of a CH_{2} on an aromatic ring.

check.zh: 报告的 COSY 表没有列出 H11/H12，本页的 COSY 里这一对按结构预期画出（*）。J ≈ 7 Hz 是典型值。
check.en: The report's COSY list does not include H11/H12; the pair is drawn in the COSY as expected (*). J ≈ 7 Hz is a typical value.

rule.zh: HMQC/HSQC 只显示一键 C–H。8 个芳碳里有 4 个带 H，另外 4 个（154.97、133.4、129.1、113.1）是季碳。
rule.en: HMQC/HSQC shows only one-bond C–H pairs. Four of the eight aromatic carbons carry H; the other four (154.97, 133.4, 129.1, 113.1) are quaternary.

so.zh: 芳香部分：4 个 CH，4 个季碳。
so.en: The aromatic part: four CH and four quaternary carbons.

check.zh: 101.3 很高场，说明这个 CH 的邻位或对位有给电子基团，比如 OCH_{3}。
check.en: 101.3 is far upfield, which suggests an electron donor such as OCH_{3} ortho or para to this CH.

title.zh: 芳香区：d、dd、d 加一个单峰
title.en: Aromatic region: d, dd, d and a singlet

ask.zh: 7.217 双峰、6.755 双二重峰、7.059 双峰，另有 7.034 单峰。前三个是什么排布？
ask.en: A doublet at 7.217, a doublet of doublets at 6.755, a doublet at 7.059, plus a singlet at 7.034. How are the first three arranged?

rule.zh: 苯环上 d（大 J）+ dd（大 J 和小 J）+ d（小 J）是 1,2,4-三取代的典型图样：邻位 ^{3}J ≈ 8–9 Hz，间位 ^{4}J ≈ 2–3 Hz。
rule.en: On a benzene ring, d (large J) + dd (large and small J) + d (small J) is the classic 1,2,4-trisubstituted pattern: ortho ^{3}J ≈ 8–9 Hz, meta ^{4}J ≈ 2–3 Hz.

so.zh: 一个三取代苯环带 3 个 H。7.034 的单峰不在这个环上，是另一个芳香 CH。
so.en: A trisubstituted benzene ring carrying three H. The singlet at 7.034 is not on this ring; it is another aromatic CH.

check.zh: 报告只用文字写了峰形，没有 J 值。图中的 J 是典型值（≈）。
check.en: The report describes the shapes in words and gives no J values. The J values in the plot are typical values (≈).

title.en: COSY: who is next to whom

text.en: 7.217 and 6.755 give a strong cross peak; 7.059 and 6.755 a weak one.

rule.zh: COSY 主要看 ^{3}J（相邻）。间位的 ^{4}J 很小，交叉峰弱。
rule.en: COSY mainly shows ^{3}J (neighbours). A meta ^{4}J is small, so its cross peak is weak.

so.zh: 6.755 的 H 夹在中间：一侧是邻位的 7.217，另一侧隔一个碳是间位的 7.059。把它们记作 H7、H6、H4。
so.en: The 6.755 proton sits in the middle: ortho to 7.217 on one side and meta to 7.059 across one carbon. Label them H7, H6 and H4.

check.zh: 7.059 和 7.217 之间没有交叉峰，说明它们是对位，不相邻。
check.en: There is no cross peak between 7.059 and 7.217, so they are para to each other, not adjacent.

title.en: HMBC: the OCH_{3} goes on C5

rule.zh: OCH_{3} 的 H 经过 O 到芳碳是 3 键。H4 到相邻碳 2 键，H7 隔两个碳 3 键。
rule.en: The OCH_{3} protons reach the aromatic carbon through the O in three bonds. H4 is two bonds from its neighbour; H7 is three bonds away across two carbons.

so.zh: OCH_{3} 接在 C5 上，C5 位于 H4 和 H6 之间。
so.en: The OCH_{3} sits on C5, between H4 and H6.

check.zh: 这也解释了 C4 在 101.3 的高场位移：它在 OCH_{3} 的邻位。
check.en: This also explains the upfield C4 at 101.3: it is ortho to the OCH_{3}.

title.zh: 还差两个不饱和度和一个 N
title.en: Two degrees of unsaturation and one N still to place

text.en: Used so far: benzene ring 4 and C=O 1, total 5. Left: C2 (CH, 124.2), C3 (113.1), C8 (133.4), C9 (129.1), one N and one N–H.

rule.zh: 还差 2 个不饱和度：一个环加一个 C=C。苯环的两个季碳（C8、C9）和 C2、C3、NH 正好围成吲哚的五元环。吲哚 C2–H 一般 7.0–7.2 ppm（单峰），C3 约 110–115 ppm。
rule.en: Two degrees remain: one ring plus one C=C. The two quaternary benzene carbons (C8, C9) with C2, C3 and NH close exactly the five-membered ring of an indole. An indole C2–H usually appears at 7.0–7.2 ppm (singlet) and C3 at about 110–115 ppm.

so.zh: 芳香部分是吲哚：7.034 的单峰是 H2，第二个 N–H 是吲哚 NH。
so.en: The aromatic part is an indole: the singlet at 7.034 is H2, and the second N–H is the indole NH.

check.zh: 吲哚有两种连法（侧链在 C2 还是 C3），H2 是单峰说明 C3 上没有 H，要用 HMBC 确认。
check.en: The side chain could be on C2 or C3. H2 being a singlet means C3 carries no H; HMBC will confirm.

title.en: HMBC: the side chain is on C3

rule.zh: H11 到它所连的 C3 是 2 键，到 C3 的两个邻碳是 3 键。
rule.en: H11 is two bonds from C3, the carbon it sits on, and three bonds from C3's two neighbours.

so.en: The side chain is attached to C3 (113.1), which is flanked by C2 (124.2) and C9 (129.1).

check.zh: 如果侧链在 C2，就看不到到 C9 的 3 键相关。
check.en: If the chain were on C2, the three-bond correlation to C9 would be impossible.

text.zh: 133.4 是最后一个季碳，报告里没有它的 HMBC 相关。
text.en: 133.4 is the last quaternary carbon, and the report lists no HMBC correlation for it.

rule.zh: 吲哚里连在 N 上的稠合碳（C7a）通常在 130–137 ppm，比 C3a 低场。
rule.en: In an indole, the ring-fusion carbon bonded to N (C7a) usually appears at 130–137 ppm, downfield of C3a.

so.zh: 133.4 是 C8（吲哚的 C7a），连着 N1 和 C7。
so.en: 133.4 is C8 (the indole C7a), bonded to N1 and C7.

check.zh: 报告也是用排除法定的 C8。
check.en: The report also assigns C8 by elimination.

text.zh: 13 个碳、16 个 H（含两个看不见的 N–H）、7 个不饱和度（苯环 4、吡咯环 2、C=O 1）都对上了。
text.en: Thirteen carbons, 16 H (including the two unseen N–H) and seven degrees of unsaturation (benzene 4, pyrrole ring 2, C=O 1) all match.

rule.zh: 8 个 HMBC 峰都在 2–3 键内；COSY 的邻位和间位关系也和 5-取代吲哚一致。
rule.en: All eight HMBC peaks are within two or three bonds, and the COSY ortho and meta relations fit a 5-substituted indole.

so.zh: 结构是 N-[2-(5-甲氧基-1H-吲哚-3-基)乙基]乙酰胺。

check.zh: 四个脂肪族 HMQC 峰报告没有列表，本页按结构预期画出（*）。OCH_{3} 放在 C5 而不是 C6，靠的是 H4 只有间位耦合、H7 只有邻位耦合。
check.en: The report does not tabulate the four aliphatic HMQC peaks; they are drawn as expected (*). Placing the OCH_{3} on C5 rather than C6 relies on H4 having only a meta coupling and H7 only an ortho coupling.
